Saxophonist Pat LaBarbera grew up in a musical family and went on to become a noteworthy soloist with the Buddy Rich Band, Elvin Jones, and as a leader of his own combo. He has also become a distinguished jazz educator in a number of Canadian universities.
Pat was interviewed via Zoom on January 5, 2021, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and I’m very pleased to have Pat LaBarbera with me this afternoon. And we are in two different countries but we’re doing the Zoom thing. Welcome, Pat.
Thank you, Monk, thanks for having me.
